title: Collaboration policy profile and overrides
description: Describes the policy contract implemented by scripts/workflow/policy.py. Full profiles require every field; project override files (.ai-workflow/policy.json) and explicit user options may provide a subset.
notes: Booleans are not valid integers (Python bool must be excluded explicitly).
Resolution order: full collaborative default -> workspace project file -> explicit user options for this run; per-field precedence follows the same order, later wins.
Selecting continuous mode adjusts plan-confirmation pacing inside an already authorized scope only; it never creates authorization and never widens host limits.
Unknown fields, duplicate JSON keys, invalid values and invalid files are reported with specific errors; there is no silent fallback to a looser mode.
policy_hash is SHA256 over the canonical JSON of the effective policy.
